main_text.l: Quidni verò? Nam ejectus extra Ecclesiam censetur traditus Satanæ, non

page.notes: Quæst. and XXXII. are marginal labels at the top left. The "ȳ" marks are verse signs and are doubtful. The numeral "11." before "Traditionem" is printed as an unclear form and may be intended as 2. Italic extent of "qualia" and "7." is uncertain. Some long-s forms were read as s. The line "Nec mandâsseт" contains a Cyrillic-looking character that should be checked: it reads as "mandâsset" in Latin. "Alex." is the catchword and is not repeated in the text.
